en: Fixed a photo sent from the Claude app over Remote Control being lost when its queued message was pulled back into the terminal prompt to edit, and the cursor moving one character for a photo with no caption
zh: 修复了通过 Remote Control 从 Claude 应用发送的照片在其排队消息被拉回终端 prompt 进行编辑时丢失的问题，以及无配文照片导致光标移动一个字符的问题
